chain.title: Something Wrong in the Stone
chain.desc: Dark Ore generates throughout the Overworld and drops Dark Gems. Everything in the First Age is cut from these.

chain.title: Loot the Dark Temple
chain.desc: Explore for a Dark Temple and recover the Environmental Accumulation Core using the book's instructions. Environmental manipulation is a separate exploration branch from building your first blood machines.

chain.title: Darkness, Compressed
chain.desc: Nine gems packed. It is also the frame of the Large Dark Tank and the Dark Bricks.

chain.title: Sticks of Dark Wood
chain.desc: The handle under the Vein Sword, the Vengeance Pickaxe and most of the mod's weapons.

chain.title: Something to Bleed With
chain.desc: Dark Gems and sticks. Spikes are how you get blood out of anything, and the Blood Extractor is made of them.

chain.title: An Apple Gone Bad
chain.desc: An apple soaked in Dark Gem. Feeding one to a mob tears open a brief anomaly.

chain.title: Somewhere to Store It
chain.desc: Prepare Dark Tanks for blood storage and place them where the relevant machine can use them. Test a small transfer first rather than assuming every device pulls from any tank nearby.

chain.title: Bottled Weather
chain.desc: Use a Weather Container with the Environmental Accumulator to capture a weather condition. Read how to release it before using a storm near a base or an exposed build.

chain.title: A Biome in a Bottle
chain.desc: Prepare a Biome Extract through the Environmental Accumulator. Test it in an area you intend to change, since using it alters the local biome rather than merely marking a location.

chain.title: Sphere of Potential
chain.desc: The battery the Accumulator drains, and the seed of the Inverted Potentia.

chain.title: The Crafter That Remembers
chain.desc: A portable crafting bench that keeps its grid; the empowered version is another Accumulator job.

chain.title: Smelted for Sight
chain.desc: Prepare a Burning Gem Stone for the tools that reveal and interact with Vengeance Spirits. Read the spirit-handling section of the book before trying to fight something you cannot yet see.

chain.title: Shut Something In
chain.desc: Follow the book's trapping procedure to seal a Vengeance Spirit in a Box of Eternal Closure. Keep track of the creature represented by each captured spirit because that identity matters to later machines.

chain.title: Origins of Darkness
chain.desc: Follow the Darkened Apple experiment to obtain the Origins of Darkness. Use its experiments to check how a new device works before connecting it to the rest of your blood workshop.

chain.title: Draw the Blood
chain.desc: Carry the Blood Extractor while making suitable kills and use its controls to collect blood stains. Watch its contents, then transfer the collected blood into storage for your first machines.

chain.title: The Dark Aura Over the Dead
chain.desc: Use the book's spirit-sight and interaction equipment to locate and defeat a Vengeance Spirit. Gather the resulting essence; ordinary attacks without the proper preparation are not the intended route.

chain.title: What the Spirit Leaves
chain.desc: The spirits' drop, and the thing the Box of Eternal Closure and the Vengeance Ring are stocked with.

chain.title: Blood That Dried
chain.desc: Allow placed blood to harden and use the supported harvesting or processing method to obtain Hardened Blood Shards. Set up this work away from pathways so the workshop stays usable.

chain.title: Gem, Fed on Blood
chain.desc: For your first Dark Power Gem, place a Dark Gem in the required pool of liquid blood described by the book. This world interaction starts the machine branch before you can use the Blood Infuser to make more.

chain.title: The Infusion Core
chain.desc: Prepare the Blood Infusion Core from the early blood materials. It becomes part of your first infusion machines; the separate Promise upgrade system controls their later recipe tiers.

chain.title: The Repairing Chest
chain.desc: It mends what you put inside using blood, at the price of a bad enchantment now and then.

chain.title: The Blood Infuser
chain.desc: Supply the Blood Infuser with blood and test a low-tier recipe. Later recipes require the appropriate Promise upgrade, so check both the available blood and the machine tier when a recipe will not run.

chain.title: Grow Something Dead
chain.desc: A tier 0 infusion. Undead wood is the only wood the Colossal Blood Chest will accept.

chain.title: The Bowl of Promises
chain.desc: Follow the Bowl of Promises preparation and infusion steps in the book. Work through the Promise upgrades in order and install the required tier before attempting advanced infusions.

chain.title: Blood From Nothing
chain.desc: Place the Sanguinary Pedestal where blood stains are produced and give it nearby tanks for the collected blood. It gathers blood from the area; it does not create a free supply in an empty room.

chain.title: Strip the Curse
chain.desc: Use blood in the Purifier to remove unwanted effects according to the selected recipe. Try it on a replaceable item before cleaning a valuable piece of repaired equipment.

chain.title: Stop Going to Temples
chain.desc: The craftable Accumulator, run on blood from eight surrounding tanks and free of the original's bad effects.

chain.title: Render the Spirits
chain.desc: Assemble the Spirit Furnace multiblock and supply a correctly captured spirit and the required blood. Check the resulting drops to confirm the captured creature is the one you intended to farm.

chain.title: An Orb Full of Blood
chain.desc: A tier 1 infusion of the empty orb; a portable reservoir for the machines that will not run dry.

chain.title: A Tear of the Corrupted
chain.desc: A tier 3 infusion, and the only route to the Entangled Chalice.

chain.title: Planks That Hold
chain.desc: A tier 2 infusion of Undead Planks, and the wall of the Colossal Blood Chest.

chain.title: Pain and Sorrow
chain.desc: Follow the final infusion route in the Origins of Darkness with the required Vengeance materials and machine tier. Your spirit-handling and blood-infusion branches meet in this late experiment.

chain.title: One Tank in Two Places
chain.desc: Create an Entangled Chalice and test its shared fluid storage between linked copies. Confirm that the intended machines can access the fluid before replacing your existing transport route.

chain.title: The Colossal Blood Chest
chain.desc: Build the Colossal Blood Chest with its reinforced undead-wood structure. Supply blood and test repairs with a few items before using it as the centre of a large equipment-maintenance system.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. This mod was not installed in the available instances, so this is upstream-source coverage, not local gameplay validation.

sources.scope: Version-matched recipes, English in-game guide and implementation; not installed locally.

coverage.scope: First blood supply, tiered infusion, spirit handling, environmental tools and late repair/farming machines.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branched prerequisites, practical instructions and primary-source coverage review.
